changesets.noneText: A change applied or proposed takes its place here.
changesets.proposalsNoneText: No pending proposal you may validate.

why.author: Only its author withdraws a changeset.
why.past: Nothing is decided out of the present: go back to the present.
why.held: An approval policy holds this changeset: another reviewer must validate it (changeset.approval.self).

changesets.changed: This changeset changed since you read it; read again
changesets.changedText: Nothing decided: the actions offered are those of its state now.
changesets.copyFailed: The browser refused to copy: copy the identifier below with Ctrl+C.
changesets.countedText: Not applied yet: the counted differential, property by property.
changesets.sectionsNoneText: No module adds a section to the differential.
changesets.motiveMissing: The motive of the rejection is required.
changesets.recordError: This changeset could not be read
changesets.authorNotice: You are the author of this changeset: another reviewer must validate it.
changesets.authorNoticeText: An approval policy holds this changeset: its author does not apply it.
changesets.diffError: The differential could not be read
changesets.diffNoneText: This changeset writes no property you may read.
changesets.diffPendingText: The differential is read once the changeset is applied; its operations say what it will write.
changesets.rejectText: The motive is sent to the author and keeps the trace of the rejection.
changesets.rejectHint: One sentence: what is missing or what to change.
changesets.undoText: A new changeset writes the inverse of this one; it applies, or waits for a review.

drafts.none: No active draft in this tab: an edit in place or an addition creates one.
drafts.onPage: The active draft is open in the page: its operations and its submission are there.
drafts.readError: The draft could not be read
drafts.expires: This draft will be deleted on {when}
drafts.expiresText: A draft left unmodified for 90 days is deleted: modify it or submit it before then.
drafts.empty: The draft is empty: an edit in place or an addition goes there.
drafts.resultViolations: {n} violation of the result | {n} violations of the result
drafts.cascaded: {n} object closed by cascade | {n} objects closed by cascade

why.past: State known at a past date: nothing is written, go back to the present.
why.violations: The simulation reports errors ({n}): correct them or remove their operations.
why.active: It is already the active draft.
why.noPanel: No edit panel for this operation: remove it, then make it again.

drafts.violationsText: Correct or remove the operations at fault to apply or submit; the draft saves as it is, violations included.
drafts.readOnly: Read only: under a past state, the draft is neither modified nor submitted.
drafts.frozen: Motive and dates fixed: “Retry” replays the submission left unanswered as sent; they can be changed once it is answered.
drafts.motiveFrozen: Motive fixed until the answer: “Retry” sends it as it was.

period.order: The end of the effect must follow its start.
period.frozen: Dates fixed until the answer: “Retry” sends them as they were.

drafts.renameText: The title helps you recognise the draft in your lists; the submission carries the motive, not the title.
drafts.renameLong: {max} characters at most: this title has {n}.
drafts.listError: Your drafts could not be read
drafts.noneYetText: An edit in place, an addition or “New draft” creates one.
drafts.retention: A draft left unmodified for 90 days is deleted; the date is announced a week before.
drafts.deleteText: Its operations are lost; nothing is applied.
drafts.gone: The active draft no longer exists: deleted, submitted or taken over elsewhere.
drafts.lost: The submission of “{title}” got no answer
drafts.lostText: The server may have applied it, and the draft has left the tab: “Retry” replays it under the same key, the server says what it did.
drafts.goneRefusedText: Deleted, submitted or taken over elsewhere: it leaves this tab, which has no active draft now.
drafts.changed: The draft changed since you read it; read again
drafts.changedText: Nothing removed: do it again if the operation is still there.
